label: Start of copy phase (<DEL> step and first ~2 outputs) in long sequences
explanation: Sparse (~1% of steps) unit that fires almost only at the start of recall: the <DEL> step (30% of mass) and copy steps outputting original tokens 1-2 (recall_idx 1 holds 46% of mass). It essentially never fires during the original phase, and fires very little after recall_idx 3. Firing rate goes up with L (L=9 holds 47% of mass, L<=5 almost none), and equivalently with to_go of 6-8. The predicate catches ~83% of activations and ~87% of the mass, but even inside that window it fires on only ~7% of steps, so which steps it picks depends on token content. Upcoming r in the next few outputs raises the rate (next_out=r gives 7.6x lift; many top examples have r at original positions 2-4), and out_tok k/u/q also raises it. But no simple token-content condition got F1 above ~0.25. The largest activations land at recall_idx 1 in L=8-9 sequences.
